items.headline: Energy One moves to acquire GMSL
items.summary: Energy One's proposed acquisition of GMSL signals further consolidation among European energy and commodity software vendors, alongside Volue's competing strategy, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: Trafigura closes upsized $4.4bn loan facility
items.summary: Trafigura finalized an upsized US$4.4bn syndicated loan package, underscoring continued bank appetite for large commodity trader financing despite earlier sector stress, per GTR.

items.headline: EU EMIR-linked regulation enters into force Oct 15
items.summary: A new EU regulation amending ESMA, EMIR, MiFIR, CSDR and related frameworks to align with the EMIR 3 reform package takes effect on 15 October, per A&O Shearman.

items.headline: CMA CGM completes FedEx Supply Chain deal
items.summary: CMA CGM finalized its roughly $1.4bn acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain, expanding CEVA Logistics' North American warehousing and contract logistics footprint amid port congestion concerns.
